officialSource.title: Rahmenlehrplan Mathematik Klassenstufen 5 bis 9/10, Rheinland-Pfalz, Mai 2007

sourceEvidence.ownParaphrase: The9/10MSA measurement introduction places sphere surface and volume in extensionE and calls for experimental approaches to volume. It explicitly does not require every formula to be derived.
The9/10MSA table explicitly includes cone and sphere in the surface/volume determination context. The retained extraction references PDFpage96; this evidence disambiguates printedpage93.

The9/10MSA probability introduction explicitly discusses MonteCarlo simulation in optional deepeningV. This proves an age/stage-appropriate possible subject context, not a mandatory requirement for every student.

The9/10MSA tableV calls for finding probabilities with simulations, model work and result interpretation. This supports the complete simulation competence in that optional context; the current supplied-result task does not elicit all of it.

durationContext: The current reviewed RP duration policy maps the9/10MSA band to final Klassenstufe9 inG8. The candidate uses that exact existing final-year examination slot. It does not modify the existing sphere targets currently printed in Orientierungsstufe.
noSourceClaimExpansion: Partial source mappings remain partial; extensionE and deepeningV remain their original source status. Existing SkillPilot targets are not relabelled as universal official requirements.
